narrative.overview: Cool, leaf-tinted daylight surrounds confident sans-serif lettering and generous original botanical still lifes. The interface is open editorial space, not a collection of cards. Imagery carries physical depth; text and controls remain simple and legible.
keyCharacteristics: Pale jade owns the page; spruce carries both meaning and action.
Onest display lettering and Geist supporting text are self-hosted and Cyrillic-capable.
Broad, gently cornered imagery alternates with open reading space.
Native disclosures offer reflection without making basic content dependent on scripts.

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: Choose cool green space over cream, navy or a dark-mode variant. The original navy/coral system is superseded.

dos: Do preserve Cyrillic parity, daylight contrast, 44px controls and readable content without scripts.
Do make the original raster still lifes decisive, with descriptive alt text and documented provenance.
Do retain the single corner language and open editorial rhythm.
donts: Don't reuse the old almanac diagrams, dark palette, rounded card grid or oversized disclaimer panel.
Don't imply that rendered vessels are branded products, the scene is a real location, or the project provides clinical services.
Don't hide content behind entrance animation or fabricate channel/shop destinations.
